notes:
Summary: ArchiveHelm is a regulated e-discovery & compliance provider exploring a private/VPC deployment for a retrieval-augmented-generation (RAG) stack. Primary focus: embeddings + reranking pipeline to index large corpora of legal documents while meeting audit/retention SLOs.

Key technical requirements (from SE call 2026-03-02):
- Index scale: ~45M unique documents -> ~180M passage-level vectors (avg 4 passages/doc). Expect growth to 80M documents in 18 months.
- Vector storage: plan for sharded ANN with hot/warm tiers. Cold archival must remain queryable for e-discovery with longer latency allowance.
- Latency targets: 95qps baseline for enterprise UI; P95 end-to-end (ANN + top-32 cross-encoder rerank) <= 350ms; soft P99 target <= 700ms. Need tail controls.
- Throughput: need burst capacity up to 300 qps for mass-review events (court discovery windows).
- Cost sensitivity: target effective cost per query <= $0.01 (including ANN + reranker); willing to trade some latency for cheaper quantized models.
- Reranking architecture: first-pass ANN (HNSW/IVF) to return ~200 candidates, followed by transformer cross-encoder reranker for legal-grade precision on top-5. Consider distilled cross-encoder for cost.
- Embedding model preferences: open models preferred (L2-normalized 1536-2048 dim), legal-finetuned encoder desirable. Versioning required.
- Security/compliance: VPC-only private control plane, SAML SSO integration, KMS/HSM for key wrap, SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence required, audit logging per document access (immutable logs), retention policy enforcement (delete-by-date, legal holds), data residency (US only).
- Observability: need token-level and route-level cost breakdown, request tracing across ANN->reranker, SLA-based alerts for P99.

Customer quotes / paraphrases:
- "We can’t accept a black-box SaaS for a year — audit trail for every document access is non-negotiable."
- "If we can’t meet 350ms P95 for our e-discovery UI, reviewers will reject the tool."

- 2026-02-18: Intro call (AE + SE) — mapped initial architecture, collected docs on retention reqs. (ff-20260218-1284)
- 2026-02-25: Security screen: requested SOC2 + ISO evidence, KMS integration details.

- 2026-03-08: Legal team raised retention window (7 years) + legal hold semantics; asked for proof-of-deletion flow and immutable audit logs.

POC ask / success metrics for 2-week pilot:
- Index 5M doc subset (20M passages) and run simulated 50 qps sustained + 200 qps burst tests.
- Show P95 and P99 latency numbers for ANN-only and ANN+reranker flows.
- Provide cost projection extrapolated to full 45M doc index (per-query cost and monthly infrastructure).
- Deliver audit log samples and deletion/retention demonstration (including legal hold).

Commercial & procurement notes:
- Prefers license + committed capacity model (private Dedicated or Private deployment).
- Procurement cycle: legal + procurement + security review; forecasted close 2026-04 if POC passes.

- KMS/HSM integration pattern — require HSM-backed key for prod. SE to provide integration doc.
- SLA for on-prem uptime and fallback behavior during maintenance windows.
